# AI and LLM standards
<!-- Generated by project-init v0.4.1. Details and reasons: docs/standards/ai-llm.md -->

## Enforced
- Model calls stay synchronous inside the Streamlit run, behind a progress display. Don't add streaming or background jobs.
- Every model call has a timeout read from `config.py`.
- Log per model call only the prompt ID and version, provider, model, latency, token counts and outcome. Never log the key, scenario text, feedback or model output, and don't add feedback collection or analytics.

## Adopting
- Pin exact model snapshot IDs in `config.py`, never `-latest` aliases.
- Set `max_tokens` per stage in `config.py`, so each run has a known worst-case cost.
- Retry transient errors (timeouts, connection errors, 429, 5xx) in one layer only: set the SDK's `max_retries` explicitly and don't wrap it in another retry loop. Never retry auth or validation errors.
- Keep the schema-repair retry separate from transport retries.
- Start each prompt file with a header giving its ID, version, the models it was tuned for and its eval cases.
